title: Four-tier motion timing
summary: The 103 distinct durations measured across the eight clips cluster into four bands: 29 under 300ms, 41 between 300 and 800ms, 20 between 800 and 1600ms, 13 above. The bands blur at their edges, but picking a value from a band and keeping to it is most of a motion system.
avoid_when: Mixing tiers: a 600ms hover or a 200ms hero both feel wrong.
recipe:
--t-micro:    120–300ms   ease / material standard / cubic-out   (hover, toggles, small UI)
--t-reveal:   320–750ms   quint-out / cubic-out                 (scroll reveals, characters)
--t-entrance: 800–1500ms  expo-out / custom out                 (hero, data bars)
--t-ambient:  2–6s        linear / ease-in-out, infinite        (glows, grain, shimmer)
